#[must_use]
pub fn has_newer_refresh_link(current: &SubscriptionToken, candidate: &SubscriptionToken) -> bool {
    candidate
        .refresh_token
        .as_deref()
        .is_some_and(|link| !link.is_empty() && Some(link) != current.refresh_token.as_deref())
}
